guidelines.detail: same as LRN-059 (The description specifies different stock conditions and corresponding actions, while the records show the flows to two of those actions are absent. LRN-059 already covers modeling conditional outcomes with branches to their stated actions.)

same as LRN-070 (The label pairs show substitutions or loss of distinctions, and the description confirms that starting to build follows the arrival of the first parts. LRN-070 already states essentially the same labeling guidance.)

refines EVT-03 (The description says work begins upon the first batch arriving, and the records show the generated model instead uses a start event for that arrival and lacks the reference flow structure. This refines EVT-03 by specifying the first-arrival case and that other arrivals need not be awaited.)

same as LRN-070 (The label pairs show modeled labels changing the described action or occurrence, while the description supplies the distinctions those labels should preserve. This is already essentially stated by learned guideline LRN-070.)

refines GW-06 (The description’s below-five and below-three thresholds can both hold, so both actions may apply. F14 records the missing flow at this decision point. GW-06 already advises inclusive splits when one or more conditions can be true; this guideline specifies the overlapping-threshold case.)

same as LRN-070 (The label pairs show semantic differences across gateways, activities, and a start event, while the description provides details such as arrival timing, when building starts, and distinct reorder thresholds. This supports preserving described meaning in labels and is already covered by learned guideline LRN-070.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an action should be taken depending on the outcome of a condition: Model the condition with an exclusive gateway and represent each stated follow-up action as a task on its applicable branch.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that different conditions on a monitored quantity lead to distinct responses

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient: Label the corresponding BPMN element so that it preserves the described action, object, scope, and direction; do not replace them with a related action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes actions, objects, scope, or outcomes for modeled elements

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a dependent activity can begin when the first of several expected arrivals occurs, while other arrivals may still be pending: Model the arrival in the ongoing process flow as an intermediate catch event, and let it enable the dependent activity without waiting for all expected arrivals or using it to start a new process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a dependent activity can begin when the first of several expected arrivals occurs, while other arrivals may still be pending

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives multiple threshold conditions on the same measure whose ranges overlap: model each applicable action as a branch that can be activated independently, using an inclusive split rather than mutually exclusive routing
rules_sent_back.situation: the description gives multiple threshold conditions on the same measure whose ranges overlap
